device.description: 12-bit 125 kSPS micropower SAR ADC with synchronous serial interface
device.note: ads7829.pdf (SLAS388) p.3-4 specifications (VCC operating range, VIH, straight binary), p.5 pin description and terminal functions, p.14 digital interface (Figure 36), p.15 Table 1 timing and data format

pages: p.3 (VIH 2.0-5.5 V), p.4 (VCC 2.7-3.6 V, 2.0-2.7 V and 3.6-5.25 V, data format), p.5 (pins), p.14 (signal levels, Figure 36), p.15 (Table 1 timing, frame description, data format)
notModeled: analog input; the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (12 clocks, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the first two DCLOCK edges (sample time 1.5-2.0 clocks), then the null bit, then B11..B0; after B0 the part outputs the result LSB-first and then zeros (all zeros for the 0 V code, so idle 0 covers it)
auto power-down after the conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
vcc 2.0-5.25 V spans the three VCC rows of the spec table (2.0-2.7 V with reduced clock rate)
variants: ADS7826 (10-bit) and ADS7827 (8-bit) share the datasheet and pinout: own spec files. ADS7829IB is the higher-grade ADS7829 (same spec).
